title: Vision Plans Member Claims for Out-of-Network Contact Lenses
content:
A Vision Plans member's new out-of-network claim is **settled on its contact-lens part** when its contact-lens and fitting receipts together exceed its spectacle-lens and frame receipts together. The member files such a claim personally. Cascade's reimbursement to the member for the claim follows the contact-lens claim rule. Once filed, the claim's lines show their remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**Scope.** This rule governs out-of-network claims settled on their contact-lens part only. An out-of-network claim settled on its glasses part is settled under the glasses claim rule, and every other out-of-network service remains under the general out-of-network reimbursement rule. For these claims, benefit frequency and contacts-in-lieu are counted under this rule, from the latest paid or reimbursed service of the kind under the current enrollment; a reversal counts only when it reverses the one service on that latest date, and a service of the other side counts only when it is dated in the same benefit period, whatever its order. The rules for exam visits, eyeglasses orders, contact-lens orders, out-of-network claims settled on their glasses part and stand-alone contact-lens fittings count them the same way. Services paid by another carrier still do not count.

## Filing tool: `file_oon_contact_lens_claim_04f2b50e`

**Capability.** `file_oon_contact_lens_claim_04f2b50e` is the member's own filing of their new out-of-network claim settled on its contact-lens part (a claim whose contact-lens and fitting receipts together exceed its spectacle-lens and frame receipts together), carrying the claim number. All of the claim's open lines — lines carrying no remark yet — are recorded at once. Each line given a remark argument receives that denial remark. Every other line receives the paid remark of its channel: `PAID` at a participating location, `PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT` at a provider without a Cascade agreement. The amount is booked on the first line not denied, in the order exam, fitting, contact lenses, lenses, frame (the first line when every line is denied), with no separate amount on the other lines. Every line's decision date is set to today. After the call the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool: the agent unlocks `file_oon_contact_lens_claim_04f2b50e` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_number` — the claim number of the claim, copied character for character from the vision claim lookup, with its letters, digits and hyphens unchanged.
- `plan_paid` — the claim's total reimbursement the member files for, as stated to the member by the agent, in USD, a non-negative number given to 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent.
- `exam_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's routine eye exam line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `fitting_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens fitting line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `contact_lenses_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's contact-lens line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `lenses_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's spectacle-lens line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `frame_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's frame line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.

A remark argument left as an empty text leaves that line to receive the paid remark of its channel.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text means the claim is recorded. It carries `claim_number` (the claim recorded), `plan_paid` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `lines` (each recorded line's reference number mapped to the remark now recorded) and `adjudicated_date` (today's date, year-month-day). A text starting "No open claim line" means no open line carries that claim number. A text starting "Not settled on its contact-lens part" means the claim's spectacle-lens and frame receipts are at least its contact-lens and fitting receipts, and nothing was recorded.
